headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee continued South Maui Community Plan changes, approving watershed and recycled water actions and a desalination study by six ayes, three noes.
meeting.recap: The committee reconvened a meeting that began September 21.[[0:00:29]] Its one item was Bill 108, 2026, the South Maui Community Plan update.[[0:06:17]] Oral testimony closed September 21, 2026, but written testimony is still accepted.[[0:06:29]] Members added an action on South Kīhei Road sections failing from coastal hazards and flooding.[[0:35:55]] They added an action to find tsunami evacuation sites outside the inundation zone, with education and signage.[[1:17:22]] They called for legislation so landowners comply with the 2024 Community Wildfire Protection Plan for South Maui.[[1:26:51]] Members approved expanding recycled water storage and distribution in South Maui.[[2:09:51]] The desalination roll call vote was six ayes, three noes.[[2:35:51]] Members approved creating a watershed management program for South Maui.[[3:38:04]] The Kīhei drainage plan action now prioritizes traditional Hawaiian cultural practices and nature-based solutions where feasible.[[4:28:20]] The chair said tomorrow's council meeting will open and recess due to the storm and the governor's closure of county facilities.[[5:52:25]] This committee continues on Monday.[[5:53:25]]
decided: Members added an action to identify tsunami evacuation sites outside the inundation zone, with education and signage.
Members added the Maui Department of Agriculture as a lead agency for the agroforestry action.
Members approved an action to expand recycled water storage and distribution in South Maui, including scalping facilities and natural earth filtering systems as applicable.
meeting.next: Items for the emergency management agency, including the new tsunami item, will be sent to that agency for feedback. A code amendment will be needed to carry out the watershed management program.

moments.q: "So water is a big concern in South Maui."
Desalination study roll call: six ayes, three noes
Storm and county facility closures change next week's schedule
